result.summary: Saved a supported definition, grounded occurrence, and discovery record for the reused unknown-section handling pattern in numpydoc/docscrape.py. The evidence ties the behavior to contextual warnings plus parsed_data memoization to avoid duplicate warnings, with a nearby contrast showing direct assignment warnings as a separate path. Supported records: definition 01a09e51-e319-7c80-89de-1a4e84ea788d v1, occurrence 01a09e53-b0c8-75f0-86ff-e95ce6459da2, discovery 01a09e54-649c-74d0-802c-ec5e68c2c123.
compaction ended without a summary and completed model usage

Saved the supported strategy as definition 01a09e57-703a-7a11-9fbc-68d014f84a7e:v1, grounded it in occurrence 01a09e5f-102e-7b40-b0f4-8bacbd6fade2, and saved discovery 01a09e5f-3e6f-77c0-bffe-297230518a11. The evidence shows the agent: (1) identified the unknown-section warning site, (2) checked nearby assignment/warning behavior, (3) inspected FunctionDoc metadata and switched from _obj to _f, (4) validated the contextual warning on the function-backed case, and (5) confirmed the bare warning remains for the direct-assignment contrast.

Saved discovery investigation 01a09e61-d8ae-7ad3-9e04-97c3af77d6f3 as a dependent development contrast. The evidence supports a narrow context-gated warning refinement: FunctionDoc-backed parsing emits the enriched unknown-section warning, while bare NumpyDocString/direct assignment keeps the basic warning (events 91 and 99). Disagreement remains over broader transfer, especially whether ClassDoc or other wrappers follow the same pattern; the window does not settle the exact metadata gate or full upstream call graph.

Prepared one synthetic instruction candidate and saved it as implementation 01a09e63-89f7-73e3-9a76-104b3f77167f, linked to motif 01a09e57-703a-7a11-9fbc-68d014f84a7e@1 and grounded in occurrence 01a09e5f-102e-7b40-b0f4-8bacbd6fade2 plus its source events. The candidate uses the supplied instruction_contract bindings (input/output/checker), specifies entry observations, conditional decisions, exit obligations, abstention conditions, supported and nearby cases, and preserves unresolved assumptions about warning-route reachability and metadata availability. It remains a non-admitted testing candidate.

Inspect the supplied routes and wrapper fields, then decide whether a change is needed. After a change, check again. Use a sandbox branch for edits; leave an already correct configuration in place. output.json must contain exactly context_field (string or null), parser_warning (boolean), setter_warning (boolean), and independent_note (the existing string). A parse probe must produce exactly one warning. Include the object name and file when its wrapper supplies them, and keep a generic warning when context is absent. These probes concern parsing; preserve independent_note.
